date_semantics: The rate periods have continuous effective dates backed by consolidated CGI editions and the cited amending finance laws. This catalog covers the CGI Article 100 periods from 2007 through its repeal effective 2020-01-01; it does not establish the predecessor regime before 2007.

gaps: No Article 100 rate period is packaged for 2004-2006. The 2006 LAR numbers the specific rates as Article 102 and uses the same values as the 2007 Article 100: 100 MAD/hl on wine and alcohol, 4 MAD/g on gold and platinum, 0,05 MAD/g on silver. That 2006 text is evidence-checked in docs/evidence/bo-5382-bis-2006-tva-rates.ocr.txt but is not exposed here, because exposing it under Article 100 would conflate the 2006 and 2007 numberings. The 2004-2005 regime remains unsourced.
Article 100 was repealed effective 2020-01-01; later taxation must be determined under the law then in force and is not mapped from these specific rates.
